\section{Calibration over time}\label{sec:s-calibration}
The smart-charging analysis shifts each forecast by quantiles of the residuals of the other driver groups from all periods. This section repeats it with quantiles computed only from residuals of other driver groups whose sessions ended before the month of the session's arrival. Both are scored on the same sessions, those with at least 200 such residuals.
